Author: Rajiv Roy

 Arising Out of Ps. Case No.-1445 Year-2010 Thana- Complaint Case Distr
 ======================================================

 Versus
 1. The State Of Bihar
 2. Geeta Devi, wife of Sri Rawan Yadav,
 3. Aarti Devi, wife of Mukesh Yadav, Daughter of Sri Rawan yadav, Both
 Serial Nos 2 and 3 are Resident of Village - Bhusri, Police Station -
 Katoriya, District - Banka.

Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Md. Nurul Hoda, Adv.
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.J.Upadhyay, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajiv Roy
 Oral Order
2 18-03-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the State.

This is an application for quashing of the order dated 09.03.2011 passed by learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Banka in Complaint Case no. 1445/2010 whereby and where under he found a prima facie case against the petitioner and took cognizance for the alleged offences under sections 498A & 323 of the Indian Penal Code.
Issue notice to Opposite Party Nos. 2 and 3 through both processes i.e. ordinary as well as Registered Cover with Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.52234 of 2015(2) dt.18-03-2023 A/D for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks failing which this application shall stand dismissed without further reference to the bench.
